rationale.conceptual: The method uses an established GGA+U correction with a specific U value and requires understanding of octahedral rotation patterns and vacancy formation thermodynamics. The extraction of the rotation angle is non-trivial but documented. The conceptual difficulty is moderate: an established algorithm requiring careful implementation, but no novel derivation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline includes multiple DFT steps: bulk relaxation, O2 molecule energy, and four separate supercell relaxations (defect-free and vacancy at two strains). This amounts to at least 6 distinct converged DFT calculations with sequential dependencies, file I/O, and post-processing. Orchestrating these jobs, handling strain constraints, and ensuring consistency is a non-trivial engineering task.
